Twelve comments

Green gowned lass

I heard this on Martin Hayes & Denis Cahill’s “Live in Seattle” CD, where it is coupled with Martin Rochford’s Reel. It was difficult to track down - it doesn’t seem to be in any of the books (unless it’s known by another name) - but a “Google” search under “green gowned lass” did the job.
I think it should be played at a gentle pace, with swing. Haven’t got round to ornaments yet. Enjoy!

↳ Posted by fidicen on October 6th, 2002.

I think M. Hayes plays it in F

At least on the studio album he does…

↳ Posted by pchaffee on June 19th, 2003.

A published source

This tune can be found, under the title Cailín an Ghúna Uaine, as tune #195 in Breandán Breathnach’s Book Ceol Rince na hÉireann 3.

↳ Posted by rwwt on March 19th, 2011.

The Green Gowned Lass, X:4

This is Mary McNamara’s setting on her album Traditional Music From East Clare. She plays it in F. Obviously I love how she falls back on the low D (low E in the G version) in the 2nd and 6th bars of the first part; that’s the melodic feature that caught my ear when I first heard this reel.
